title: Public pack details leak a private build path
request: Public API pack-detail responses are hydrated with fresh fields from each source's metadata. We found that the hydrated `browser_artifact` block can carry a private filesystem path (`local_artifact_path`) from the private build, which must never appear in a public response. Fix the pack-detail hydration so public pack details still include the browser artifact metadata (storage key, hashes, sizes, timestamps) but never include `local_artifact_path`. Keep the change small and add or update tests if useful. Do not change unrelated behavior.
notes: Small security-boundary fix. Grader is the test the accepted commit added; the model does not see it.
